set.body: Goal: centralize visual defaults now scattered across GraphicParams defaults, RowPhase point size, GuideSpec gp defaults, and LayoutPolicy sizes into a Theme value (fonts, base sizes, palettes, guide styling, panel background/grid) threaded through the compiler and solver. Acceptance: one Theme reaches every default; a non-default theme changes axis/legend/panel styling without touching specs; LayoutPolicy sizing derives from theme typography; JVM+JS tests.
set.title: Graphics: theme system
